met_analysis:
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Ferozepur, Dehradun, Gorakhpur, Patna, centre of Depression over Jharkhand and adjoining northern parts of Gangetic West Bengal & thence southeastwards to Northeast Bay of Bengal.
The Shear Zone roughly along Lat. 22°N across central & adjoining north Peninsular India between 3.1 & 9.6 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Haryana & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Jammu Division & neighbourhoodat 5.8 km above mean sea level with a trough aloft at its axis at 7.6 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 70°E to the north of Lat. 30°N persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over East Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over West Madhya Pradesh now lies over northwest Madhya Pradesh & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over central parts of Rajasthan between 3.1 & 4.5 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
